picture.description: Photo of a full-size display mockup of the rover at an exhibition on 8 November 2026, seen from the front; before sending, everything outside the vehicle was painted white and the maker's name, flag decals and NASA insignia were covered with the colour around them

simplifications: The picture is a front view of a display mockup, so the generator guessed the sides, the back and the underside.
Thin parts (suspension links, the cab frame) are rough, and some surfaces are torn or merged.
Scaled evenly to the maker's height of about 2.6 m to the top of the antenna; width and length are measured from the shape and shown beside the maker's 2.3 m and 4 m for comparison.

The antennas came out only as short stubs below the roof box, so the top of the shape is the roof box; scaled to a height measured to the top of the antenna, the shape may therefore be slightly too large.
All colours, textures and markings removed; one plain grey material.

finishing.material: one neutral material; every texture, image, UV coordinate, per-vertex colour and original material removed
